srcline: Sourced reporting · DDPM, TMD and DMR as carried by the press
chartSub: Fires, collapses, explosions, hazmat and other incidents by month. Hover a bar for deaths.
status: A curated record, not a full count. 40 records for Jan–Sep 2026 from English-language reporting. Small fires, road crashes and most of the Deep South and Northeast are missing.
notes: Every record is a report, not a finding. Each links to its article and keeps who gave the figures. None has been confirmed by an analyst.
Protests are not incidents. The three rallies recorded were peaceful. They are shown on the map but not counted as incidents.

Figures may change. The Lat Phrao fire toll of 41 comes from a later report; the first injury count of 73 was never confirmed, so injured is left blank. The Makkasan crash is dated 16 May, though one outlet says 17 May.
Some records overlap with other tabs. The Sikhio crane and Makkasan crash also concern rail. Myanmar earthquakes are placed where shaking was felt in Thailand, not at the epicentre.
Wildfire counts are hotspots. Hotspot figures come from satellite data cited by the press. They show where burning was detected, not separate fires.
